name: ORBCore refund-before-sell reentrancy with pair-reserve burnLP
summary: ORBToken forwards BNB it receives to ORBCore.addPoolAndSell, whose sell branch refunds the BNB to the caller before selling, and _sellToken pays the caller before calling ORBToken.burnLP, which burns up to 20% of the pair's ORB and syncs; none of this is reentrancy-guarded and Core's own swaps are tax-free. With flash-loaned and Venus-borrowed WBNB the attacker first bought almost all ORB out of the ORB/WBNB pair, then re-entered at the refunds so that 58 nested sells ran their burnLP calls against the emptied reserve on the way out, grinding its ORB side to dust, and a final sell drained the pair's WBNB.
notes: Direct immutable ORBCore; the owner's wiring within 1,101 blocks of deployment (setOther, addFilterSpecialAddressArr, setLpTo, setMinterAddress, setBNBLimit and ORBToken.setAddress(core), last at block 109761315) only made it operational, and minBNB, whiteListOpen and the sell/burn ratios read the same at 109761119 and 121296109.

WBNB depletion of the ORB/WBNB pair 0x64fad72e5dde70b2960497744b348fd64cb4788c across the transaction (45.318191861188781185 -> 0.335708357864918575), less the attacker's pre-held 3,483.438204554125976510 ORB valued at the pre-exploit reserve ratio (0.027093460559344606 WBNB). Sell taxes routed to leader2 are not deducted; borrowed legs are repaid in-transaction and excluded.

ORBToken 0xc4d27261c06407053cad16cb825ecc0eee7ee7d7 (deployed earlier, block 109718211, runtime 0x437b1483ebe856784080bd939f5349ccf1e5faddf87dd03837371e231885b651) supplies the unguarded receive() forwarding and burnLP; it is the older artifact, so ORBCore's later deployment is the knot.
